text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Urara-san!? How long are you going 
to stay half-asleep? Hurry up and change 
into your uniform!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not asleep... I'm riding properly... 
on the carrot..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
King-chan, you're in the back~... I'll 
take you to Carrot Park... mumble.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What kind of dream are you even having?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Agh, you're drooling all over the place... 
Wipe it off, quickly! Every single 
morning, whhyyy does it end up like this?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
――No, no, no!! I wanna go to school in my 
racing outfit today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh~... I hear ya, I hear ya. Now, go get 
changed into your racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Of course. But what a shame. I was going 
to give dumplings to the good girls who 
wear their uniforms properly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...! On second thought, let's go with the 
school uniform! And for the dango, 
mitarashi flavor it is!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Geez, every single morning... you never 
get tired of this, do ya? Still, the real 
showdown starts now—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! A birdie! Where is it going, I 
wonderー?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to get an itch to move! 
Turbo's gonna go run!
